card.name: Punctuation inside economics paper citations
card.fires_on: Punctuation and title words in academic reference lists and RePEc-style paper listings, such as the period after a year or month, a quote mark opening a title, or a colon inside a title. Also the first word of an abstract after a title.

modes.label: Citation punctuation
modes.description: Periods, colons or opening quotes between author, year, title and journal in economics reference entries.
modes.example: Environmental and policy factors shaping e-commerce diffusion<<:>> a cross country comparison

modes.label: Abstract start after title
modes.description: The word This or the space that begins an abstract right after a paper title.

card.writes: It suppresses past-tense verbs like was, were, showed and differed, so it steers away from verbs describing results.
card.plain: It fires in economics reference lists and paper listings, at the punctuation between author, year and title.
